name: Karam Alhamad
description: Karam Alhamad is a Syrian-German builder of public infrastructure for open societies, and an Ethereum Foundation Next Billion Fellow (2022-23). A political detainee under Assad, stripped of his ID papers, he left Syria in 2014. He founded ZeFi Foundation, his open-source umbrella, and its flagship Nawafith is the open civic register of the Syrian state, built between Berlin and Damascus with Syrian civil-society partners and shipped as an Arabic-first kit others can replicate.
